title: Feature Request: Recover un-submitted prompt accidentally cleared
body:
**Feature Request**
When a prompt being typed is cleared with ctrl-c it would help to have an "undo" to bring it back.

**Background**
All too often I'm typing up a detailed prompt and a few parapgraphs in I go to paste in a filename reference or similar with crtl-v and my fingers hit ctrl-c instead. It doesn't help that I'm often jumping between desktop and laptop and phone and laptop-with-keyboard-via-dock so muscle memory gets thwarted.
Every time I have this accidental ctrl-c and lose a big chunk of planning I remind myself "I should always draft larger prompts in a notes app first...." but when multi-tasking a bunch of claude's this doesn't always happen.

If I could hit ctrl-z or similar after a ctrl-c clearing to bring it back again this would be hugely appreciated!

Thanks :-D
author: andrewleech
